newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-ISTANBUL POLICE TO ENLIST WOMEN AGAINST SWEARING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ISTANBUL POLICE TO ENLIST WOMEN AGAINST SWEARING.

text.p: Istanbul police are trying to attract more women supporters to football matches to help cut down on swearing, Anatolian news agency reported on Thursday.

Suleyman Basgor, officer in charge of public order in Istanbul, said measures had to be taken against swearing in the stands and the best way to do this was to get more women to go to matches, the agency said.
"The clubs and federation have promised to help in this matter," he said at a meeting of directors from Istanbul's top soccer clubs and the football federation.
"People chanting rude words will be prosecuted," he added.n
